title: Cancellation for Nonpayment and Reinstatement Figures by Named Non-Owner Policy Package
content:
The figures that time a cancellation for nonpayment and a reinstatement on the Named Non-Owner Policy are set per package as follows.

| Package | Notice mailed this many calendar days after the unpaid installment's due date | Smallest past-due amount for which a notice is issued (USD) | Reinstatement window after the cancellation effective date (calendar days) | Most reinstatements with a lapse within one term |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits | 1 | 5.00 | 10 | 1 |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner Minimum Limits with UM | 1 | 5.00 | 10 | 1 |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner 50/100/50 | 1 | 5.00 | 15 | 1 |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/200/50 | 3 | 10.00 | 15 | 2 |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/300/50 | 3 | 10.00 | 20 | 2 |
| Cardinal Point Non-Owner 250/500/100 | 5 | 10.00 | 30 | 2 |

Figures common to every package:

- **Minimum notice days:** the schedule of minimum notice days for cancellation for nonpayment is the Owner Auto Policy's nonpayment notice days by state (single source).
- **Statement of No Loss age:** at most 3 calendar days between the signing of the Statement of No Loss and the processing of the reinstatement or late renewal it supports.
- **Reinstatement effective offset:** 1 day is added to the later of the payment posting date and the Statement of No Loss signing date to give the reinstatement effective date.
- **Postmark receipt days:** a payment postmarked on or before the cancellation effective date counts as on time only when it is received within 10 calendar days after the cancellation effective date.

**Worked reading (hypothetical dates).** On Cardinal Point Non-Owner 100/200/50, an installment due on 4 March with 12.40 past due: the notice may be mailed on 7 March at the earliest (the due date is day 0, plus 3 days), and the amount qualifies because it is at least 10.00. On the same package a past-due amount of 9.99 is below the smallest amount for a notice.
